content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 4 up, 1 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 6. Sets: 94 (last week 94).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- Barbell Bench Press: 82.5 kg x 8 (last week 80 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.1%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Row: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Back Squat: 115 kg x 5 (last week 115 kg x 5), flat (3 weeks without a new best), 4 sets this week
- Leg Press: 160 kg x 10 (last week 157.5 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 1.6%, 8 sets this week
- Romanian Deadlift: 90 kg x 8 (last week 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 8 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): Barbell Bench Press 82.5 kg x 8; Barbell Row 70 kg x 8; Leg Press 160 kg x 10; Romanian Deadlift 90 kg x 8.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for Chest, Back, Side delts, Rear delts, Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Biceps, Triceps; the others have no range): Chest 20 (last week 20), Back 26 (last week 26), Front delts 16 (last week 16), Side delts 12 (last week 12), Rear delts 10 (last week 10), Quads 12 (last week 12), Hamstrings 12 (last week 12), Glutes 20 (last week 20), Biceps 16 (last week 16), Triceps 20 (last week 20), Calves 2 (last week 2).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "Squat 140 kg".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- lift_stalled (priority 60). Advice: Double progression: keep the weight and add reps on every set until all sets reach the top of the rep range, then add the smallest jump (2.5 kg upper body, 5 kg lower body).
    - Barbell Back Squat: data {"name":"Barbell Back Squat","nameZh":"深蹲","best":"115 kg x 5","previousBest":"115 kg x 5","change":0,"bodyweight":0,"flatWindows":3}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next week about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
